an9.43:1.2: kittāvatā nu kho āvuso kāyasakkhi vutto bhagavatāti.
an9.43:2.1: idhāvuso bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi …pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an9.43:2.2: yathā yathā ca tadāyatanaṃ tathā tathā naṃ kāyena phassitvā. viharati.
an9.43:2.3: ettāvatāpi kho āvuso kāyasakkhi vutto bhagavatā pariyāyena.
an9.43:3.1: puna caparaṃ āvuso bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā …pe… dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ …pe…
an9.43:3.4: yathā yathā ca tadāyatanaṃ tathā tathā naṃ kāyena phassitvā viharati.
an9.43:3.5: ettāvatāpi kho āvuso kāyasakkhi vutto bhagavatā pariyāyena.
an9.43:4.1: puna caparaṃ āvuso bhikkhu sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamma paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ‘ananto ākāso’ ti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati …pe… sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma anantaṃ viññāṇanti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma natthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati …pe… sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati,
an9.43:4.2: yathā yathā ca tadāyatanaṃ tathā tathā naṃ kāyena phassitvā viharati,
an9.43:4.3: ettāvatā pi kho āvuso kāyasakkhi vutto bhagavatā pariyāyena,
an9.43:5.1: puna caparaṃ āvuso bhikkhu sabbaso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja viharati paññāya cassa disvā āsavā parikkhīṇā honti.
an9.43:5.2: yathā yathā ca tadāyatanaṃ tathā tathā naṃ kāyena phassitvā viharati,
an9.43:5.3: ettāvatāpi kho āvuso kāyasakkhi vutto bhagavatā nippariyāyenāti.
